note: EVERY VALUE IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER (status assumed, ASSUMED_PLACEHOLDER) written on 2026-09-13 so that gen18proc.metrics.compute_metrics can produce a cost proxy; none is a quoted or sourced price. Open item U5 of DESIGN.md section 16: a person replaces each value with a quoted price (supplier, date, region) and sets status to literature with a source. Until then reagent CONSUMPTION is the primary economic number and the cost proxy is secondary and is reported together with the ranges below. Units are per mol of reagent (acid as mol H+ of HCl/HNO3, base as mol NaOH, salting anion as mol of added nitrate/chloride salt, complexant per mol, extractant make-up per mol of extractant molecule) or per litre (diluent, water).

acid.note: placeholder order of magnitude for technical HCl / HNO3 per mol H+; no source; replace under U5

base.note: placeholder order of magnitude for NaOH per mol (saponification of the acidic extractant); no source; replace under U5

salting_anion.note: placeholder for an added nitrate / chloride salt per mol of anion; no source; replace under U5

complexant.note: placeholder for a hydrophilic hold-back complexant per mol consumed (1 - regeneration fraction); wide range because the complexant is not yet chosen (open item U3); replace under U5

extractant_makeup.note: placeholder per mol of extractant (acidic organophosphorus or diglycolamide class) lost to bleed and entrainment; no source; replace under U5

diluent.note: placeholder per litre of aliphatic diluent leaving with the organic bleed; no source; replace under U5

water.note: placeholder per litre of process water (scrub + strip + dilution); no source; replace under U5
